intro_paragraphs: Java Volcano Tour Operator (JVTO) is a registered Indonesian travel company based in Bondowoso and led by an active Tourist Police officer. We design private, all-inclusive itineraries to Mount Bromo, Ijen Crater and Tumpak Sewu with clear safety rules, transparent pricing and real local impact.

All tours are private — no shared buses. Every package includes transport, accommodation, permits, English-speaking guides, and meals as stated. Health screening is conducted the evening before the Ijen night trek.
Official channels: Website https://javavolcano-touroperator.com • WhatsApp +6282244788833 • Email hello@javavolcano-touroperator.com.

# Surabaya Landing Page — Website Copy

---

## Hero Section

### H1
Private Volcano Tours from Surabaya — Police-Led, All-Inclusive, Zero Hidden Costs

### Subheadline
11 private packages: Kawah Ijen, Mount Bromo, Tumpak Sewu & Madakaripura. Your own vehicle. Your own crew. Led by an active Tourist Police officer.

### Credibility Line
Licensed operator NIB 1102230032918 · Trustpilot 4.8/5 (51 reviews) · Founded 2015

---

## Lead Paragraph

Every JVTO tour from Surabaya is 100% private — your group, your vehicle, your schedule. Mr. Sam, the founder, is an active officer of the Indonesian Tourist Police (Ditpamobvit East Java): every route, safety decision, and written rule traces back to someone who answers to police protocol. What's included is written before you book. What it costs is confirmed before you pay.

---

## Package Section

### Section Heading
11 Private Tours from Surabaya

All packages: dedicated vehicle, English-speaking crew, entrance fees, accommodation + breakfast, mineral water, JVTO T-shirt. Price per person — no hidden local payments.

---

#### 1-Day Package

**1 Day Bromo Midnight Experience**
Depart Surabaya after midnight. Penanjakan sunrise point, Bromo crater rim by morning, return Surabaya same day. Private 4WD Jeep for the crater area included.
*From IDR 1,550,000/person (2 pax) · IDR 1,000,000/person (11+ pax)*

---

#### 2-Day Packages

**2 Day Bromo Sunrise Adventure**
Penanjakan sunrise, Bromo crater, Madakaripura Waterfall — the tallest waterfall in Java — in two days. Return to Surabaya on Day 2.
*From IDR 2,800,000/person (2 pax) · IDR 1,750,000/person (11+ pax)*

**2 Day Ijen Blue Fire Expedition**
Night hike to Kawah Ijen Crater. Blue Fire is a natural phenomenon subject to weather and gas activity — visibility depends on conditions at the time of your hike. Gas masks and trekking poles provided by JVTO. A health certificate is mandatory for every guest before Kawah Ijen crater entry, per BBKSDA SE.1658/KSA.9/2024; JVTO coordinates clinic workflow for every guest under BBKSDA SE.1658/KSA.9/2024.
*From IDR 2,300,000/person (2 pax) · IDR 1,550,000/person (11+ pax)*

---

#### 3-Day Packages

**3 Day Ijen, Bromo & Madakaripura — Surabaya Return**
Kawah Ijen night hike (Day 1–2), Mount Bromo sunrise and crater (Day 2–3), Madakaripura Waterfall canyon (Day 3). Ends back in Surabaya.
*From IDR 3,570,000/person (2 pax) · IDR 2,450,000/person (11+ pax)*

**3 Day Bromo, Madakaripura & Ijen Overland — Surabaya to Bali**
Bromo sunrise, Madakaripura canyon, Ijen crater — finishing in Bali (ferry crossing Gilimanuk–Ketapang included). One-way Surabaya–Bali overland.
*From IDR 3,570,000/person (2 pax) · IDR 2,450,000/person (11+ pax)*

---

#### 4-Day Packages

**4 Day Ijen, Bromo & Madakaripura Expedition — Surabaya Return**
Extended version of the 3D2N route. Additional time buffer for Bromo caldera and Madakaripura approach.
*From IDR 4,450,000/person (2 pax) · IDR 3,025,000/person (11+ pax)*

**4 Day Ijen, Papuma Beach, Tumpak Sewu & Bromo Journey — Surabaya Return**
Four destinations: Kawah Ijen crater, Papuma Beach coastal break (Jember), Tumpak Sewu curtain waterfall (~120 m), Mount Bromo sunrise. Ends Surabaya.
*From IDR 4,550,000/person (2 pax) · IDR 3,125,000/person (11+ pax)*

**4 Day Tumpak Sewu, Bromo & Ijen Adventure — Surabaya to Bali**
Same four-destination circuit as above, finishing in Bali with Gilimanuk–Ketapang ferry included.
*From IDR 4,550,000/person (2 pax) · IDR 3,125,000/person (11+ pax)*

---

#### 5-Day Packages

**5 Day Ijen, Papuma Beach, Tumpak Sewu & Bromo Nature Trip — Surabaya Return**
Full East Java circuit with relaxed driving days: Ijen, Papuma Beach, Tumpak Sewu, and Bromo. Returns to Surabaya.
*From IDR 5,050,000/person (2 pax) · IDR 3,650,000/person (11+ pax)*

**5 Day Ijen, Bromo, Madakaripura & Malang City Adventure — Surabaya Return**
Volcano circuit plus Malang city on Day 4–5 before returning to Surabaya.
*From IDR 5,250,000/person (2 pax) · IDR 3,850,000/person (11+ pax)*

---

#### 6-Day Package

**6 Day Ijen, Papuma Beach, Tumpak Sewu, Bromo & Malang City Discovery — Surabaya Return**
JVTO's widest single tour. All five East Java highlights — Ijen, Papuma, Tumpak Sewu, Bromo, Malang — over six days with realistic driving pacing.
*From IDR 6,050,000/person (2 pax) · IDR 4,750,000/person (11+ pax)*

---

## What's Included Section

### Section Heading
Every package includes — in writing

All 11 packages include the following. No surprise local payments.

- **Private transport**: AC MPV (1–3 guests) or Toyota Hiace (4–9 guests). Fuel, tolls, and parking included.
- **Dedicated crew**: English-speaking driver-guide (1–3 guests), or professional driver + escort guide (4+ guests). Licensed local site guides at key locations.
- **Entrance fees and permits** to all attractions on the itinerary.
- **Accommodation + breakfast** (all overnight packages, per itinerary).
- **Private 4WD Jeep** for Bromo crater area (Bromo-inclusive packages). One jeep per ≤4 guests; additional jeeps arranged for larger groups.
- **Gas masks and trekking poles** (Ijen-inclusive packages).
- **Health-certificate screening coordination** for Ijen routes for every guest under BBKSDA SE.1658/KSA.9/2024.
- **Daily mineral water supply**.
- **Full pick-up to drop-off assistance** from your Surabaya hotel or address.
- **JVTO travel T-shirt** (1 per participant).

**Not included**: flights, tips, personal expenses, travel insurance, Indonesian VISA (if applicable).

---

## Why JVTO Section

### Section Heading
The facts behind the booking

**Police-Led Operations**
Mr. Sam holds the rank of Bripka and serves as an active officer of Ditpamobvit East Java (Tourist Police). Independent national press — Detik.com, 2021-03-14 — confirms active-duty status. No other tour operator in East Java is led by a serving Tourist Police officer.

**100% Private — No Shared Groups**
Your booking receives a dedicated vehicle and crew. No join-in option exists. Group size determines vehicle type (MPV or Hiace); timing and route decisions apply to your group only.

**All-Inclusive — Written Before You Book**
Inclusions and exclusions are published on every package page and confirmed in your voucher. The voucher is the booking reference. Mid-trip negotiations over ticket costs, fuel, or meals do not occur on JVTO routes.

**Verifiable Credentials**
NIB 1102230032918 is verifiable via the Indonesian OSS system. HPWKI membership is registered under AHU-0001072.AH.01.07.TAHUN 2024. BBKSDA clearance and POLPAR authorisation are on file. All guides hold KTA credentials (2024 issuance). Dr. Ahmad Irwandanu holds a valid SIP license (Kemenkes/KKI verifiable).

---

## Trust Signals Section

### Section Heading
Check us before you book

| Signal | Source |
|---|---|
| Trustpilot: 4.8/5 · 51 reviews | Independent (verified 2026-05-09) |
| Google Maps: 4.90/5 · 123 reviews | Independent |
| TripAdvisor: 4.95/5 · 21 reviews | Independent |
| NIB 1102230032918 | OSS-verifiable |
| Founder: active Tourist Police officer | Detik.com press record, 2021 |
| ISIC Student Tours | Provider ID 259268 (isic.org verifiable) |
| Founded: 2015 | Booking.com 2015 award, Stefan Loose Reiseführer p. 287 |

JVTO does not ask for CVV codes, OTP codes, or online banking passwords via chat or email. Pay only via the official JVTO website, listed bank accounts, or confirmed WhatsApp +62 822 4478 8833.

---

## Booking Section

### Section Heading
Book direct — no agency fees

1. **WhatsApp** +62 822 4478 8833 with your dates, group size, and preferred package.
2. Receive a price confirmation (per the pricing table for your group size).
3. Pay a 20% deposit via Xendit secure checkout (card or QRIS) to confirm the booking; if Day 1 is within 14 days, up to 100% may be required.
4. Receive your e-voucher with full trip details and a pre-trip guide.

**Deposit**: 20% of total (up to 100% if Day 1 is within 14 days), via Xendit secure checkout — card or QRIS. Wise or bank transfer for the balance.
**Balance deadline**: card — 5 days before Day 1 · bank wire/Wise — 3 days before Day 1.
**Cancellation ≥ 48h before Day 1**: 100% converted to Lifetime Package Credit (no expiry, transferable).
**Cancellation < 48h before Day 1**: forfeited. No Package Credit.

**Student pricing available** for verified ISIC cardholders (Provider ID 259268). Ask at booking.

**Group incentive (direct bookings only)**: 18 paying guests → 1 free place · 35 paying → 2 free places · 50 paying → 3 free places + 5% group discount.

## Route Overview

Bali to East Java — what the route looks like

All four Bali packages cross from Bali to East Java by ferry on Day 1. Three packages finish in Surabaya (one-way overland); one package returns you to Bali on Day 3. ---

## Package Section

### Section Heading
4 Private Tours from Bali

All packages: dedicated vehicle, English-speaking crew, ferry crossing (Gilimanuk–Ketapang), entrance fees, accommodation + breakfast, gas masks + trekking poles (Ijen), mineral water, JVTO T-shirt. Price per person — no hidden local payments.

---

### 3-Day Packages

**3 Day Bromo & Ijen Volcano Discovery — Returns to Bali**
The only Bali-return package. Cross to East Java on Day 1, reach Bromo side for sunrise staging. Day 2: Bromo crater sunrise (private 4WD Jeep included), Madakaripura Waterfall canyon, transfer to Bondowoso for Ijen staging. Day 3: Ijen night hike, descent, and ferry return to Bali.

*Day-by-day:*
| Day | Summary | Hotel |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Bali → ferry → Bromo side | Joglo Kecombrang Bromo |
| 2 | Bromo sunrise · Madakaripura · transfer to Bondowoso | Riverside Homestay |
| 3 | Ijen climb · descent · return ferry → Bali | — |

*From IDR 4,050,000/person (2 pax) · IDR 2,850,000/person (11+ pax)*

---

**3 Day Ijen, Bromo & Madakaripura — Bali to Surabaya**
Ijen first, Bromo second. Cross to Banyuwangi on Day 1 for Ijen staging. Day 2: Ijen night hike, transfer west to Bromo side. Day 3: Bromo crater sunrise, Madakaripura Waterfall, finish in Surabaya. Solo pricing available.

Blue Fire is a natural phenomenon subject to weather and gas activity. Gas masks provided by JVTO. A health certificate is mandatory for every guest before Kawah Ijen crater entry, per BBKSDA SE.1658/KSA.9/2024; JVTO coordinates clinic workflow for every guest under BBKSDA SE.1658/KSA.9/2024.

*Day-by-day:*
| Day | Summary | Hotel |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Bali → ferry → Banyuwangi for Ijen staging | Luminor Hotel |
| 2 | Ijen climb · descent · transfer to Bromo side | Joglo Kecombrang Bromo |
| 3 | Bromo sunrise · Madakaripura · finish in Surabaya | — |

*From IDR 7,500,000/person (solo) · IDR 4,050,000/person (2 pax) · IDR 2,850,000/person (11+ pax)*

---

### 4-Day Package

**4 Day Ijen, Papuma Beach, Tumpak Sewu & Bromo Expedition — Bali to Surabaya**
Four destinations across four days. Cross to Banyuwangi on Day 1 for Ijen staging. Day 2: Ijen crater, transfer to Papuma Beach coastal area (Jember). Day 3: Tumpak Sewu curtain waterfall (~120 m), transfer to Bromo side. Day 4: Bromo crater sunrise, finish in Surabaya. Solo pricing available.

*Day-by-day:*
| Day | Summary | Hotel |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Bali → ferry → Banyuwangi for Ijen staging | Luminor Hotel |
| 2 | Ijen climb · descent · transfer to Papuma | Doho Homestay |
| 3 | Tumpak Sewu · transfer to Bromo side | Joglo Kecombrang Bromo |
| 4 | Bromo sunrise · finish in Surabaya | — |

*From IDR 9,050,000/person (solo) · IDR 4,900,000/person (2 pax) · IDR 3,475,000/person (11+ pax)*

---

### 5-Day Package

**5 Day Ijen, Papuma Beach, Tumpak Sewu & Bromo Discovery — Bali to Surabaya**
Extended version of the 4D3N circuit with additional time built into each transfer segment. Recommended for groups who prefer a less compressed pace. Cross to Banyuwangi on Day 1; finish in Surabaya on Day 5.

*Day-by-day:*
| Day | Summary | Hotel |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Bali → ferry → Banyuwangi for Ijen staging | Luminor Hotel |
| 2 | Ijen climb · descent · transfer to Papuma side | Doho Homestay |
| 3 | Papuma area · transfer to Tumpak Sewu staging | Joglo Kecombrang Bromo |
| 4 | Tumpak Sewu · transfer toward Bromo | Joglo Kecombrang Bromo |
| 5 | Bromo sunrise · finish in Surabaya | — |

*From IDR 5,450,000/person (2 pax) · IDR 4,050,000/person (11+ pax)*

content.h1: Mount Bromo — East Java's Most Iconic Volcano
content.body_md:
# Mount Bromo — East Java's Most Iconic Volcano

**Meta description:**
Private Bromo sunrise tours from Surabaya. Penanjakan viewpoint, sea-of-sand 4WD jeep, overnight option. Tourist Police-led. Licensed operator NIB 1102230032918. From IDR 1,550,000/person.

---

## Hero

**Headline:**
The Sea of Sand, the Smoking Crater, the Sunrise That Justifies a 03:00 Start.

**Credibility sentence:**
JVTO holds BBKSDA national-park operator clearance and a POLPAR licence issued to a serving Tourist Police officer — every piece of documentation is publicly verifiable before you pay.

---

## Destination Overview

Mount Bromo (2,329 m) sits inside the vast Tengger Caldera in Probolinggo Regency, East Java — one of the most recognisable volcanic landscapes on earth. The caldera floor is a ~10 km² expanse of grey volcanic sand that gives the "Sea of Sand" its name. Across this open plain, Bromo's crater vents a near-constant smoke plume while the higher rim of the caldera frames the horizon.

The draw is three-layered: the **Penanjakan viewpoint** at 2,770 m delivers the signature pre-dawn panorama over the entire caldera system; the **4WD jeep traverse** across the sea of sand is not an access road but the experience itself — a 20-minute crossing through volcanic silence; and the **crater approach** offers a close view of an actively smoking vent. Most guests come for the sunrise. Many say the crater walk is the moment they remember.

The optimal window is narrow: 03:00 departure from accommodation, on the road to Penanjakan before first light, in position for the colour transition at sunrise, then down to the caldera floor by 07:00. JVTO pre-arranges the 4WD jeep so guests arrive at the parking area and transfer directly — no on-the-day negotiation.

---

## Volcanic Status — Conditional Notice

> [stale?] The alert-level content below was accurate as of 2026-05-16 (Level II Waspada). No active update feed exists. Verify current PVMBG/BBKSDA status before publishing this section. If Level I, remove this block or replace with the generic closure SOP text.

**Current alert level: Level II — Waspada (Elevated), effective 2026-05-16 (verify before publishing).**

PVMBG (Indonesian Centre for Volcanology and Geological Hazard Mitigation) raised Mount Bromo to Level II Waspada on 16 May 2026, establishing a 1 km exclusion zone around the crater rim. This means the trail to the crater lip is currently restricted.

**What remains fully accessible:** The Penanjakan sunrise viewpoint (2,770 m) is outside the exclusion zone and operates as normal. The sea-of-sand jeep traverse and the Pura Luhur Poten temple area on the caldera floor are also outside the 1 km radius and remain open to visitors.

**What is currently restricted:** The final approach to the crater rim itself — the viewpoint directly over the active vent — falls within the 1 km exclusion zone. JVTO will not take guests to the crater lip while Level II is in effect.

**Effect on JVTO's standard Bromo itinerary:** Minimal. The Penanjakan sunrise, sea-of-sand crossing, and caldera floor exploration are the primary experiences of a JVTO Bromo tour and are unaffected. JVTO's Plan-B framework is active: your guide contacts you before arrival to confirm the adjusted itinerary. No day is lost.

---

## Why JVTO for Bromo

JVTO's founder, Mr. Sam (Bripka Agung Sambuko), is an active officer of the Indonesian Tourist Police (Ditpamobvit East Java). No other licensed East Java tour operator has this structure at its head. The consequence for guests: route decisions are made by someone who answers to police protocol, not marketing metrics.

Every JVTO Bromo tour is 100% private. Your group receives its own vehicle, driver, and dedicated crew — no shared jeeps, no strangers, no compromise on timing. JVTO holds BBKSDA national-park operator authorisation: guests enter Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park without paperwork friction or queuing at a separate permit counter.

All-inclusive means all-inclusive. Private transport, entrance fees, the Bromo 4WD jeep, accommodation and breakfast, mineral water, and a JVTO travel T-shirt are bundled. There are no surprise local payments. The written inclusions and exclusions are published on the booking page — read them before you pay.

NIB 1102230032918 is checkable at the OSS portal. POLPAR, BBKSDA, and HPWKI credentials are listed on the credentials page. Trustpilot rating: 4.8/5 from 51 verified reviews.

---

## Bromo Tour Packages

All packages depart from Surabaya unless stated. Pricing is per-person; lower rates apply to larger groups.

**1 Day Bromo Midnight Experience** (`bromo-1d1n`)
Midnight departure, Penanjakan sunrise, sea-of-sand jeep, crater area, return to Surabaya same day.
From IDR 1,000,000/person (11+ pax) · IDR 1,550,000/person (2 pax)

**2 Day Bromo Sunrise Adventure** (`bromo-2d1n`)
Overnight in Cemoro Lawang, extended caldera time, milky-way stargazing on clear nights (weather permitting).
Pricing available on the package page.

**Multi-destination packages (Bromo + Ijen and/or Madakaripura)**
JVTO offers eleven additional packages combining Bromo with Kawah Ijen, Madakaripura Waterfall, Tumpak Sewu, and Bali transfer — ranging from 3D2N to 6D5N. See the full package list for pricing by group size.

---

## Practical Information

**Best season:** Dry season, April–October. Clear skies and firm volcanic sand. Wet season brings mist and muddy access roads — sunrise views may be obstructed.

**Temperature at Penanjakan (pre-dawn):** 5–15°C (41–59°F). Warm layers are required — wind chill at the viewpoint is significant regardless of daytime temperature at lower elevation.

**Travel time from Surabaya:** Approximately 3 hours to Cemoro Lawang. Standard departure from Surabaya is around midnight to reach Penanjakan before first light.

**Physical requirements:** The crater approach (currently restricted under Level II Waspada) involves a short walk or optional horse ride on uneven volcanic terrain. The Penanjakan viewpoint and sea-of-sand jeep portion have no significant physical demands beyond normal mobility.

**What's included on all Bromo-inclusive JVTO packages:**
Private transport (AC vehicle, fuel, tolls, parking) · Dedicated driver and guide · BBKSDA national-park entrance fees · Bromo 4WD private jeep · Accommodation and breakfast (overnight packages) · Mineral water (daily) · JVTO travel T-shirt

**What's not included:** International or domestic flights · Gratuities (guest discretion) · Horse riding at the crater (optional, arranged on-site, extra cost) · Personal expenses

---

## Book a Bromo Tour

Private Bromo tours depart year-round. Availability is confirmed directly via WhatsApp.

WhatsApp: +62 822-4478-8833
Email: hello@javavolcano-touroperator.com

Inquiry process: message with your dates, group size, and preferred package. JVTO confirms availability and sends a price quotation based on your group size. A 20% deposit secures the booking.
